name: Textarea
description: Multi-line text entry. It shares Input's field anatomy (label, box, hint, error) and adds an optional character counter.

props.name: rows
props.description: Visible lines of text. With autoResize, the minimum.

props.name: maxLength
props.description: The most characters allowed. Sets maxlength on the control and shows the counter.
props.a11y: The counter is aria-hidden; a polite live region announces the characters left only near the limit.

props.name: autoResize
props.description: Grows the box with its content (CSS field-sizing). Emitted as data-auto-resize.

props.name: label
props.description: The visible label, linked to the control.

props.name: hint
props.description: Help text under the box, linked with aria-describedby.

props.name: error
props.description: Validation message. Marks the field invalid and is linked with aria-describedby.

props.name: invalid
props.description: Marks the field invalid without a message. Emitted as data-invalid.

props.name: readonly
props.description: Makes the control read-only. It stays focusable.

props.name: required
props.description: Marks the field required and shows the required mark.
props.a11y: Sets required (and so aria-required) on the control.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder text. Never a replacement for the label.

props.name: value
props.description: The value. Livewire binds it with wire:model, Vue with v-model.

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The initial value of an uncontrolled textarea.

props.name: remainingLabel
props.description: The counter's announcement near the limit. {count} is replaced with the characters left. Livewire translates the default.

props.name: errorField
props.description: The validation key to read from $errors. Defaults to the wire:model name.

props.name: classes
props.description: Extra classes per part, such as { label: '…', control: '…' }.

parts.name: root
parts.description: The field: label, box, hint and error.

parts.name: label
parts.description: The visible label, for the control.

parts.name: required
parts.description: The required mark inside the label. Hidden from screen readers; the control is required.

parts.name: box
parts.description: The bordered box around the control and the counter.

parts.name: control
parts.description: The native textarea. Attributes other than class land here.

parts.name: count
parts.description: The counter, such as 118 / 500, at the end of the box. Shown with maxLength.

keyboard.action: Moves focus to the control; typing edits the value and Enter adds a line.

requirements: The label is always visible and linked with for/id; a placeholder never replaces it.
Hint and error are linked to the control with aria-describedby.
Invalid sets aria-invalid on the control; the error is text, never color alone.
The counter is aria-hidden. A polite live region announces the characters left once within 10% of the limit (at least 10), never on every keystroke.
Class goes to the root; every other attribute (wire:model, name, autocomplete) goes to the control.
Disabled uses --apui-surface-sunken and --apui-text-disabled, never opacity alone.
Visible focus ring on the box while the control has :focus-visible.
